name: fp32 accumulation rerun
command:
ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@spark 'cd ~/bonsai2/asm && python3 - <<PYEOF
s = open("tq_gemv_int.c").read()
o1 = "        double acc = 0;"
n1 = "        float acc = 0.0f;"
assert s.count(o1) == 1
s = s.replace(o1, n1, 1)
o2 = "            acc += (double)ws * (double)sum; (void)CS;"
n2 = "            acc += ws * sum; (void)CS; /* fp32 order mirrors fork generic exactly */"
assert s.count(o2) == 1
s = s.replace(o2, n2, 1)
o3 = "        y[r] = (float)acc;"
n3 = "        y[r] = acc;"
assert s.count(o3) == 1
s = s.replace(o3, n3, 1)
open("tq_gemv_int.c", "w").write(s)
print("patched to fp32 accumulation")
PYEOF
LB=~/bonsai2/llama.cpp/build/bin && gcc -O2 -DTQ_XGEMV_LIB -o tq_gemv_int tq_gemv_int.c tq_xgemv.c fwht.S -L$LB -lggml-base -lggml-cpu -Wl,-rpath,$LB -lm && taskset -c 3 ./tq_gemv_int ../models/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-PTQ1_0.gguf 11120992 594124800 64' 2>&1 | tail -4
